# GitHub Automation Instructions

Parent: [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)

The repository maintainers own this folder's hosted automation. `.github/dependabot.yml` configures
dependency updates, and `.github/workflows/` owns GitHub Actions workflows.

Read [`../docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md) for the repository documentation map. Keep action
versions, supported runtimes, package-manager versions, and invoked repository commands aligned
with the manifests they exercise.
